title: 第9章 素未谋面的灵石第10章 宗门要散
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 唐落天在她入定前教她转化灵力的时候也顺便跟她说了修士的境界，从低到高分别是练气，筑基，金丹，元婴，化神，渡劫，飞升。
练气期又分为十二层与大圆满，而筑基期以上的境界不再细分，只分初中后以及大圆满四个小境界。
说了一会话后，柳苗苗从后面广场上一堆东西中拿出了一个荷包。
“来，这是师兄姐们给你准备的见面礼。”
巫未央双手接过，“谢谢师姐师兄。”
“打开看看。”
柳苗苗笑眯眯说道。
巫未央依言打开，里面是几张黄色的符纸。
“这是几张符箓，看，这个图案的就是疾行符，能加快你行走的速度，这个是水系攻击符，还有这个是轻身符，有了它你从比较高的地方跳下来也不会受伤。”
柳苗苗给她介绍，“这些低阶符箓不需要灵力，疾行符和轻身符贴在身上就能用，攻击符你撕开一角扔出去就可以，记得扔快点。”
巫未央听完它们的作用和使用方法，意识到师姐师兄们给的是逃命的东西，心下有些感动，“我都会记住的。”
另一旁的叶葵也手痒痒的捏了捏她脸颊，“真乖。”
唐落天此时打断他们，“好了，快把采买的东西放好吧。”
说完，他又对巫未央道，“既然你炼气一层了，明天也要来学堂上课，掌门每天早上都会给我们讲一些知识的。”
巫未央点头，等师兄师姐们忙完，她才又找到唐落天，问他这次遇到的疑惑。
“那是因为灵气被身体吸收了，我们每次突破，经脉变宽，身体变强，都是灵气的作用。”
唐落天听完，也没怎么思考就给她解释了，这些都是修炼的基础问题。
“我们一步步突破，身体被改造，不再像凡人那样需要吃饭，也不会生病。”
“当然，这得筑基期，你现在才炼气一层，还是要吃饭的。”
巫未央的肚子适时地咕噜一声，她顿时红了脸。
唐落天哈哈一笑，摸出一块大烧饼给她。
就这样，巫未央在朝天宗住了下来，每天执着地修炼着。
时间如白驹过隙，半年一晃而过。
巫未央每日除了吃饭听课，就是修炼，只有偶尔扛不住了才睡一觉。
经过半年的努力，她丹田里的灵气团也有拳头那么大了。
巫未央将新引入的灵气都归纳在丹田后，又将体内一种灰白的气团一一排出，检查了一下保证经脉干干净净后，她才停下修炼。
灰白的气团便是多灵根修炼过程中产生的杂气，起初巫未央十分惊慌，这种气团不受控制，会从丹田中飘出，堵塞在经脉里，久了还会越来越凝实，让灵气团都飘不动。
后来唐落天教了她吐纳的方法，她学会将杂气排出后才定下心来。
停下修炼的巫未央走出房门，现在正好是早晨，可以去听掌门讲课。
一夜未睡，巫未央依旧精神抖擞，虽然以她现在的修为，还不能完全用修炼代替睡觉，可偶尔熬几个通宵是没问题的。
content_en:
When Tang Luotian taught her how to transform spiritual power before she entered trance, he also told her about the realms of monks. From low to high, they were Qi training, foundation building, golden elixir, Nascent Soul, transformation into gods, overcoming tribulations, and ascension.
The Qi training period is further divided into twelve levels and Dzogchen, while the realms above the foundation period are no longer subdivided, and are only divided into four small realms after junior high school and Dzogchen.
After talking for a while, Liu Miaomiao took out a purse from a pile of things in the square behind.
"Come here, this is the meeting gift prepared by the senior brothers and sisters for you."
Wu Weiyang took it with both hands, "Thank you, senior sister and brother."
"Open it and take a look."
Liu Miaomiao said with a smile.
Wu Weiyang opened it as instructed, and there were several yellow talisman papers inside.
"Here are some talismans. Look, this one is a running talisman, which can speed up your walking. This one is a water attack talisman, and this one is a light body talisman. With it, you won't be hurt even if you jump from a relatively high place."
Liu Miaomiao introduced to her, "These low-level talismans do not require spiritual power. The speed talisman and the light body talisman can be used by sticking them on the body. For the attack talisman, you can tear off a corner and throw it out. Remember to throw it quickly."
After hearing their functions and usage, Wu Weiyang realized that what the senior sisters and brothers had given them were tools for escaping, and she felt a little moved in her heart, "I will remember them all."
Ye Kui on the other side also pinched her cheek itchingly, "You're so good."
Tang Luotian interrupted them at this time, "Okay, quickly put away the things you bought."
After finishing speaking, he said to Wu Weiyang, "Since you have reached the first level of Qi Refining, you will come to the school tomorrow. The master will teach us some knowledge every morning."
Wu Weiyang nodded, and after the brothers and sisters finished their work, she found Tang Luotian again and asked him about the doubts he encountered this time.
"That's because the spiritual energy is absorbed by the body. Every time we break through, the meridians become wider and the body becomes stronger, it's all the result of the spiritual energy."
After Tang Luotian listened, he explained to her without much thinking. These are the basic issues of cultivation.
"We have made breakthroughs step by step, and our bodies have been transformed. We no longer need to eat like ordinary people, and we will not get sick."
"Of course, this is the foundation building stage. You are only at the first level of Qi Refining, so you still need to eat."
Wu Weiyang's stomach growled at the right time, and she immediately blushed.
Tang Luotian laughed and took out a big sesame seed cake for her.
In this way, Wu Weiyang settled down in Chaotian Sect and practiced persistently every day.
Time flies by like a fleeting moment, and half a year flies by.
In addition to eating and listening to classes, Wu Weiyang practiced every day. He only took a nap occasionally when he couldn't bear it anymore.
After half a year of hard work, the aura in her Dantian was as big as a fist.
After Wu Weiyang collected all the newly introduced spiritual energy in her Dantian, she discharged a gray-white air mass from her body one by one. She checked to ensure that her meridians were clean before she stopped practicing.
The gray air mass was the miscellaneous air produced during the multi-spiritual cultivation process. Wu Weiyang was very panicked at first. This kind of air mass was uncontrollable and would float out of the Dantian and block the meridians. Over time, it would become more and more solid, making the spiritual energy mass unable to float.
Later, Tang Luotian taught her how to breathe out, and she calmed down after learning to expel the impurities.
Wu Weiyang, who stopped practicing, walked out of the room. It was morning now, so he could go and listen to the master's lecture.
After not sleeping all night, Wu Weiyang is still full of energy. Although with her current cultivation level, she cannot completely replace sleep with practice, but it is no problem to stay up all night occasionally.
